snippet.title: Lumi Master - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Pre-Register Today and Begin Your Cozy Journey ✨
👉 https://lumipr.onelink.me/cxtl/69e8lovj

Welcome to Lumi Master, a casual, heartwarming monster-collecting and management game set in a hand-drawn fairy-tale world.

Explore at your own pace, meet adorable Lumis freely, grow your collection, and build a warm and cozy home of your own. Journey through charming regions, discover hundreds of unique Lumis, complete your collection, and enjoy light strategy battles along the way.

Gather materials, decorate your home, and let your Lumis help bring your little world to life.

Pre-register now and start your Lumi journey!
https://lumipr.onelink.me/cxtl/69e8lovj

Follow us on social media
X: https://x.com/lumimasterEN 
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/profile.php?id=61587561267671

Discord: https://discord.gg/JF86YUP8tu
